description: 8-AI remote RTU I/O, Modbus RTU RS-485 9600 8N1. FC03: AI_range ch0-7 (704-711, 0=0-10V 1=0-20mA 2=4-20mA-burnout), AI_burnoutValue f32 ch0-7 (736,737,738,...751 step-2 pairs). FC04: AI_rawValue (704-711), AI_rawValueMin (736-743), AI_rawValueMax (768-775), AI_engValue f32 step-2 (800-815), AI_engValueMin f32 step-2 (864-879), AI_engValueMax f32 step-2 (928-943), AI_status (992-999, 0=normal 1=burnout 2=over 3=under). FC01: AI_resetMinValue (704-711), AI_resetMaxValue (736-743).
source: Omni Console device library (OmniCoreST), modbus-library/moxa-iologik-r1240.toml; Source: ioLogik R1200 Series User Manual V3.2, November 2017 (Appendix). Not verified against the manufacturer's documentation

| FC04 addr 0x02C0-0x02C7 (704-711): AI raw value ch0-7
| FC04 addr 0x02E0-0x02E7 (736-743): AI min raw value ch0-7
| FC04 addr 0x0300-0x0307 (768-775): AI max raw value ch0-7
| FC04 addr 0x0360,0x0362...0x036E (864,866,...878): AI min eng. value ch0-7 (f32, step-2 pairs)
| FC04 addr 0x03A0,0x03A2...0x03AE (928,930,...942): AI max eng. value ch0-7 (f32, step-2 pairs)
